name: use-calendar
title: useCalendar
description: useCalendar: the calendar block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the calendar block (`npx better-supabase add calendar`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/calendar.
